dataset: EgoDex (Hoque et al. 2025, arXiv:2505.11709) — recorded Apple Vision Pro hand and head motion, replayed through MABEL's own headset wire format
note: every clip is the SAME episode its metrics row was scored on, snapshotted from that run rather than re-simulated

methods.label: Direct copy
methods.why: Copy the operator's joint angles onto the robot. A human arm is longer and a human torso about three times wider, so equal ANGLES do not put the hand in the same place.

methods.label: Abs. scaled
methods.why: Take the headset-relative hand position, scale it by one number, command it. What most VR teleop interfaces ship.

methods.label: Wrist IK
methods.why: Solve the same wrist pose we do, but hold the fingers at a fixed functional preset. Isolates what per-finger retargeting is worth. Reimplementation, not the authors' code.

methods.label: Extension
methods.why: Carry the operator's ARM EXTENSION across per shoulder. Exact in extension, distorting in shape — MABEL's shoulders are much narrower, so both hands pull inboard.

methods.label: GMR
methods.why: Root-uniform scaled keypoints anchored at the mid-shoulder, with every MABEL addition switched off. The base our stack builds on.

methods.label: WB IK
methods.why: Whole-body differential IK: no posture atlas, a heavy elbow objective, a slow distal trust region. Reimplementation.

methods.label: Ours
methods.why: GMR keypoints plus the offline front-workspace posture atlas, per-finger keypoint IK, the standoff clamps, the head-anchor low-pass and the mobile-base re-anchor.
